remarks:
Welcome to 267 Bragg Road! This beautiful country home has only had one owner and is looking for the next buyer to call it home! With 1.7 acres of land, it sits cozily on the hillside, showcasing the beautiful views of Chautauqua County. The main level has an inviting feel, with an open concept between the living room and kitchen. The granite counter tops, stainless steel appliances and electric fireplace, makes this space perfect for everyday living and entertaining guests. The 2023 home also features large windows that showcase the natural light and the best views of the surrounding landscape. Continuing to the back of the home, you can find the primary bedroom with an on-suite full bathroom,walk-in shower and large walk-in closet. 
Stay warm in the colder months with the pellet stove and multiple smart wall heaters that are already affixed to the walls in the bathrooms, primary bedroom and the lower living area.
The lower level features a wet bar, complete with a sink, cabinets and a fridge. A full bathroom with laundry hookups and a utility closet, and a finished area that is currently being utilized as a den/office completes the basement.
 Walking out the front door, you'll find the inviting covered concrete patio, which is great for relaxing and entertaining. This home has appropriate egress for this to be a full primary bedroom, in-law suite, or a possible investment property, with minimal work needed to separate the two levels. An 8X10 storage shed comes with the property for extra outdoor storage space. Located in the Frewsburg School District, it is in between the Kinzua Resevoir and Chautauqua Lake, minutes from game lands, and less than an hour from Holiday Valley Ski Resort! 267 Bragg Road is waiting for you to make it your next place to call home, vacation home, hunting camp or investment property!

**Delayed Showings & Negotiations until Saturday, September 12, 2026 at 11 AM.**
